characters.name: Tunde Adeyemi
characters.role: Danfo conductor. Quick mouth, quick feet, loyal, takes the hits.

characters.name: Amaka Nwosu
characters.role: Phone-repair and hacking genius. Sharp, funny, fearless.

characters.name: Chidi Nwosu
characters.role: Amaka's little brother, pulled into the Red Cowries.

characters.name: Baba Sule
characters.role: Femi's old partner and Tunde's mentor. Drives the bus Shina took.

characters.name: Zainab Yusuf-Cole
characters.role: Independent journalist chasing the Kingmaker's money.

characters.name: "Sir Jaguar"
characters.role: Head of the Red Cowries, Shina's muscle.

characters.name: Shina Garage
characters.role: Motor-park strongman. Runs the levies and owes favours upward.

characters.name: Kemi Lawson-Bright
characters.role: Island party promoter who knows everyone's secrets.

characters.name: Hon. Dapo "Kingmaker" Akinsola
characters.role: Running for governor, and Shina's sponsor.

characters.name: Chief Barnabas "Big Bar" Okon
characters.role: The Big Man who funds the Kingmaker from his Eko Crest tower.
